Data:Nxh.n.rose.revealed.aladim.t.bookof.desc: 'I have what I need to establish the Glaeterfleoge-kind among my patroness's gardens. I fear for the future. I fear this may even be the beginning, at last, of the long-rumoured Pilgrimage to the place above the Mansus… well, if that's so, I will be released from my service. And I serve with less willingness every day. But this is not your concern. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.rose.revealed.arun.t.bookofmi.desc: 'I will show the Cross the deep springs of Miah… metaphorically. And, perhaps, practically.  The Vagabond will be pleased. Calyptra will be inconvenienced. And I will enjoy the desert air.'

Data:Nxh.n.rose.revealed.dagmar.t.bookof.desc: 'Sort of like showing the old cousin round the old pied-à-terre in Brest, what? Make sure they know how to jiggle the chain on the old WC, which waiters not to annoy downstairs, sort of thing. But drier. And bigger. Much bigger. I'm going to get into trouble for this, aren't I? Well, worse things happen at sea.'

Data:Nxh.n.rose.revealed.olympe.t.bookof.desc: 'I wish the Cross no especial ill. But their time is past, and ours is now: we must be realistic. I have found a secret in Miah that will distract them - I can ask my friend to lead them to it. They will have no part in the Vagabond's campaign against Calyptra...'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.buried.stanislav.r.rite.desc: ''What is buried is never lost….' On reflection, I will not staunch the flow of dreams. It is very likely that the Cross will return. When they do, it will be important that we and they understand one another.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.buried.stanislav.t.cucu.desc: 'I've shared some of this lore with the Church in Strasbourg - my more radical contacts there. Thank you, Librarian. I think now that it's time for change, and this will be part of that change.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.buried.stanislav.t.thef.desc: ''What is buried is never lost….' On reflection, I will not staunch the flow of dreams. It is very likely that the Cross will return. When they do, it will be important that we and they understand one another.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.buried.stanislav.t.thes.desc: ''What is buried is never lost….' On reflection, I will not staunch the flow of dreams. It is very likely that the Cross will return. When they do, it will be important that we and they understand one another.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.burnt.aladim.r.herbs.in.desc: 'I have worked with my friends in the Church to dispense suitable nostrums. Thank you, Librarian. For the most part, these chitin-dreams will remain in the dark of the Wood.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.burnt.aladim.r.orchids..desc: 'I have worked with my friends in the Church to dispense suitable nostrums. Thank you, Librarian. For the most part, these chitin-dreams will remain in the dark of the Wood.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.burnt.aladim.r.quenchin.desc: 'It is done.  I can find no trace of the Cross that remains in Strasbourg. I will remain watchful…'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.drowned.stanislav.r.her.desc: 'It's done. I've advised the Church on mixtures that will suppress the dreams. And this whole business has made me think. The Cross are not our enemies. But these dreams of eyes… I fear they cannot be our friends. Perhaps their return to the world is inevitable. But I hope not. It grieves me, but I believe we should work to keep them far from daylight.'

Data:Nxh.n.saint.drowned.stanislav.t.the.desc: ''What is buried is never lost….' On reflection, I will not staunch the flow of dreams. It is very likely that the Cross will return. When they do, it will be important that we and they understand one another.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.captured.arthur.echidna..desc: 'Lieutenant Moore: how nice to meet you at last. Won't you come with me? Yes, that's it. I'm so glad you're not going to be difficult. And thank you, Librarian. Ligeia remembers.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.captured.arthur.r.coil.c.desc: 'I daren't face her; but I think I can manage a ward that will turn her gaze aside from me. I'll have to be careful, but then, when haven't I been? Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.captured.arthur.t.dehori.desc: 'The Labyrinth's allies weren't very sympathetic. I'm more disposable than I'd thought. But now I think I can argue my case a lot better… and if I'm lucky, those allies will be prepared to keep Echidna at bay, for a while at least. I'm very grateful, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.captured.arthur.t.echidn.desc: 'Echidna has very few weaknesses. But what's in here gives me so me hope. Perhaps I can make myself unpalatable enough to discourage her? Let's hope so, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.free.zachary.r.pentiment.desc: 'Thank you… my friend. I will give of my blood and the Sun's old shadow may remember how it was when the days were red and sweet… what is within, without. I will rise into the sky and - please may it be so - I will not return. Do not grieve for me. Do not grieve...'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.free.zachary.t.coloursin.desc: 'Bischoff saw; Bischoff knew. Thank you… my friend. I will give of my blood and the Sun's old shadow may remember how it was when the days were red and sweet… what is within, without. I will rise into the sky and - please may it be so - I will not return. Do not grieve for me. Do not grieve...'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.azita.azita.echidn.desc: 'Azita, my dear, it's been so long. Shall we discuss this business somewhere quiet? I wouldn't want to disconcert the Librarian. And thank you, Librarian. Ligeia remembers.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.azita.azita.r.coil.desc: 'Thanks, Librarian. I think I know how to stay out of her way. Not forever - and I intend to live as close to forever as I can manage - but long enough to find a more permanent solution.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.azita.azita.t.debe.desc: 'There's a pleasant surprise! Right here in plain sight, for those with eyes to see… I can't defeat Echidna, but I can make her regret a confrontation - enough to keep her at bay. Like a cat scratching a bear's nose, you know? Thanks, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.chaima.chaima.echi.desc: 'Lalla Chaima. I have been looking forward to our meeting. Come with me, and we will discuss the matter of Abecassis, discreetly. There; yes; that's right; that's fitting, isn't it…? And thank you, Librarian. Ligeia remembers.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.chaima.chaima.r.co.desc: 'There is no defeating Echidna. The best I can hope for is to turn her gaze aside from me. I know now how to do that. Walk in light, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.chaima.chaima.t.ec.desc: 'This is what I need. I won't face her. But if she comes for me, I will have some surprises for her. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.skin.slain.chaima.chaima.t.th.desc: 'I have never heard that one can blackmail a Ligeian. But I will try to do just that. Perhaps, Librarian, I will see you again after all.'

Data:Nxh.n.tapestry.investigated.connie..desc: 'This brings it back! … this is what I got into the Bureau to do. This is what I've always been good at. Thanks, Librarian. I'll stay, and fight to keep things right.'

'Collers really was a piece of work, wasn't he? You know, Lady Edith has his picture in her office... this clinches it for me. I can do more good outside the Bureau than inside. This is going to cause a fuss: I'll need to lie low for a while.  Thank you, Librarian. I couldn't have made this decision without you. I hope we meet again some day.'

[Connie will resign from the Bureau, and will no longer appear as a Visitor, but may still be recruited to the Lighthouse Institute...]

'I'd forgotten how dangerous the older powers can be. We take them for granted. Thank you, Librarian. It's easy to get too focused on Nowhere, but there are so many other perils out there, and the Bureau has always worked to protect us all. I'll stay with the Bureau, and work to keep things right.'

'Thirza Blake... she never really fitted, either, did she? But this brings it all back… this is what I got into the Bureau to do. This is what I've always been good at. Thanks, Librarian. I'll stay, and fight to keep things right.'
